message.title: Invitation to presentation of Kongsberg Maritime s third quarter 2026 financial results
message.body:
Kongsberg Maritime's financial results for the third quarter of 2026 will be
published at 07:00 CET on Friday, 30 October 2026. The quarterly report and
presentation material will be available at
https://www.kongsbergmaritime.com/investor-relations/reports-and-presentations/
and www.newsweb.no.

A live webcast will begin at 08:15 CET and can be accessed via
https://www.kongsbergmaritime.com. Participants will have the opportunity to
submit questions online during the presentation.

About Us
Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology.

We deliver advanced solutions to merchant, offshore, fishing, and naval
vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations
- both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with
customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real
challenges at sea.

Today, over 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board.

Kongsberg Maritime has over 8,400 employees in 35 countries.
